defect_detail.why_this_matters_beyond_one_test: The failure mode is INDISTINGUISHABLE at the headline from a real product regression - both read as "24 passed / 1 failed" on the exact test that guards MT-120 attribution. This session lost a cycle to it, and the packet has already been bitten twice by wall-clock budgets: the git history records a 10s deadline red-ing under 51-way parallelism, and the MT-108 sweep found four binaries that only pass at --test-threads=1. A budget that thin is a proof that reports on machine load.
defect_detail.explicitly_not_a_request_to_weaken_the_p: The bound exists so a hung managed-runtime scenario cannot wedge the suite, and that purpose must survive. This MT asks for a budget derived from measured worst case with real headroom, not for the bound to be deleted or quietly raised until the test stops failing.

acceptance_criteria.AC-128-1: The child budget is derived from a MEASURED worst case with stated headroom, and the derivation is recorded in the contract. A number changed with no measurement behind it does not satisfy this.
acceptance_criteria.AC-128-2: A reap must be DISTINGUISHABLE from a product failure without reading source. The reap path must report the observed child elapsed time, the budget it exceeded, and the last gate the child reached, so a future runner can tell a slow machine from a broken product at the headline.
acceptance_criteria.AC-128-3: The bound still fires. Prove it RED: force the child to exceed the budget (e.g. an injected stall behind a test-only env var) and show the reap path triggers and cleans up. A budget that can no longer fire is a deleted guard, not a widened one.
acceptance_criteria.AC-128-4: `cargo test --manifest-path src/frontend/handshake_native/Cargo.toml --test test_e7_swarm_edit_proof -- --test-threads=1` returns 25 passed / 0 failed on a machine carrying concurrent build load, not only on an idle one.
acceptance_criteria.AC-128-5: No product source is touched. git diff HEAD for src/frontend/handshake_native/src/** and src/backend/** is empty for this MT.
